record.summary: Framework for generative AI developed by IMDA and the AI Verify Foundation, expanding the Model AI Governance Framework for traditional AI. It sets out nine dimensions to be looked at in totality: accountability along the AI development chain, data quality and contentious training data, trusted development and deployment with 'food label'-type transparency, incident reporting, third-party testing and assurance, security against new threat vectors, content provenance such as watermarking, safety and alignment R&D, and AI for the public good. It calls on policymakers, industry, the research community and the public to do their part.
record.notes: IMDA and the AI Verify Foundation released a proposed framework for international views on 16 Jan 2024 and, drawing on the feedback, finalised it on 30 May 2024, when IMDA also announced an AI Governance Playbook for Digital FOSS. The framework builds on the June 2023 Discussion Paper on Generative AI by IMDA, Aicadium and the AI Verify Foundation, and is meant as a first step: implementation guidelines and resources are to follow under each of the nine dimensions.

summary.quote: It requires all key stakeholders, including policymakers, industry, the research community and the broader public, to collectively do their part. There are nine dimensions which the Framework proposes to be looked at in totality, to foster a trusted ecosystem.
Accountability is a key consideration to incentivise players along the AI development chain to be responsible to end-users.
This involves industry adopting best practices in development, evaluation, and thereafter "food label"-type transparency and disclosure.
it is valuable for companies to adopt third-party testing and assurance to demonstrate trust with their end-users.
Governments are looking to technical solutions like digital watermarking and cryptographic provenance.
Generative AI introduces the potential for new threat vectors against the models themselves.
expanding on the existing Model AI Governance Framework for Traditional AI.
